name: THSV StreamBridge - Translate
author: surakage
description: Performs creator-approved, timeout-bounded manual or automatic translation requests for the combined Translate add-on.

actions.name: THSV Addon - Translate - Push to Talk

manualTriggerSetup: Translate Text needs no trigger: StreamBridge runs it after you approve it.

Optional: put THSV Addon - Translate - Push to Talk on a Stream Deck button or hotkey. pushToTalkAction toggle starts and stops listening; use start and stop for two buttons. It needs no approval. Optional per button: pushToTalkOutput (chat, captions or both) pushToTalkPlatforms (for example youtube or twitch,kick) and pushToTalkLanguages (for example es or es,ja); empty uses the wizard settings.
triggerSafety: Translate Text is broker-dispatched only; do not attach triggers to it. Push to Talk publishes one bounded local relay and does not send chat or call external APIs itself.
verificationStatus: Source and package structure tested; live provider and platform-chat acceptance remains creator-verified.
